text_block_list.text:
The intense summer training camp finally 
came to an end, and on the day we returned 
to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...So this training camp is coming to an 
end already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This year's training camp was so much fun. 
I could really feel the richness of the 
"present"... I think it's become an 
unforgettable summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However—our target race is drawing closer 
in the not-too-distant future."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll reset my mindset and get back on 
track, so once we return to the academy, 
I'll be in your care once again.

The autumn GⅠ campaign was just around the 
corner. I braced myself for the final 
stretch of training with Mejiro Ardan...!
